invariants.rule: Only explicit btc-recorder and es-nq-recorder identities are accepted
Only authoritative owner-context task visibility is accepted
Task identity, action, single-instance and restart policy match exactly
Task state alone never establishes health
Heartbeat, instances, gaps, integrity, storage and clock remain fail closed
Records are immutable, deterministic and content addressed
Source hashes and collection times are preserved and validated
The adapter and readiness result never grant trading authority
